text.tspan: Song view compresses all clips and takes an
First time entering song view only one clip will be present.
Clips can be created, re-ordered, deleted in song view.
Hold [SONG] + Turn (SELECT) to switch Row/Grid View
The mute / launch column pads now takes on the ‘launch’ functionality when in song
view. Rows containing clips are illuminated. Pressing the corresponding LAUNCH
pad will trigger the clip for that row. When the sequence is playing launch will firstly
arm the clip, then launch it, played in time with the sequence.
Press to select the clip and switch to clip view.
The audition / section column pads now takes on the ‘section’ functionality when in
song view. Rows containing clips are illuminated and coloured based on the section.
Sections enable groups of clips to be launched and controlled simultaneously. Clips
can be armed, stopped, played together as a group.
one row each in song view.
